limits: Offline candidate for exactly one retained component; not a global source/coverage audit or an installation.
Two independently retrieved current OSM snapshots retain individual member versions/dates; no source date is inferred from a single relation timestamp.
Original source-parent evidence supports shared OSM administrative geometry; official authority, semantic crosswalk and physical-water adjudication remain unapproved.
Only exact intersections with the retained component are added. Existing geometry outside it is not replaced with a wholesale current source county.
Every positive-area outside-component/source, lost-coverage or overlap flag and lower-dimensional residual must be reviewed; no tolerance, snapping, buffer or MakeValid closes them.
Candidate properties preserve old identity/parent metadata for inspection; installation needs explicit mixed-source provenance and must not call the candidate the unchanged older native source.

Derived ownership, environment, canonical grid, immutable release, full geographic regression and branch/content scope revalidation remain necessary before live use. Original claims/history stay on their original identities and footprint contexts.
Inherited water pilot date, source encoding and registration limits remain unresolved; no dry-land or water assignment is inferred.
No core data, hierarchy, existing research packets, production/provider/database, publisher chat or deployment changes.
metadata_policy: Candidate retains baseline properties to inspect identity/history preservation. Installation requires explicit mixed-source footprint provenance; unchanged old metadata must not certify candidate coordinates.
